# Utility Explained

> Utility bills decoded: electric, gas, water, and sewer charges explained with worked math, decision frameworks, and verified sources (EIA, EPA, DOE, published tariffs).

Base URL: https://utilityexplained.com

This site publishes original, source-cited guides. Every article carries a Quick Answer, worked cost math, and dated primary-source citations.

## Key pages

- [average-utility-bills-by-state-2026](https://utilityexplained.com/blog/average-utility-bills-by-state-2026/) Average electric, gas, and water bills by state (2026) — EIA-sourced national and state-level data with stated vintage.
- [electricity-explained](https://utilityexplained.com/electricity-explained/) Electricity hub: kWh, supply vs delivery charges, demand fees, time-of-use rates — every line on an electric bill.
- [gas-explained](https://utilityexplained.com/gas-explained/) Natural gas hub: therms, CCF, customer charges, winter rate spikes — every line on a gas bill.
- [water-explained](https://utilityexplained.com/water-explained/) Water hub: CCF, sewer charges, stormwater fees, meter reading — every line on a water bill.
- [heating-cooling-explained](https://utilityexplained.com/heating-cooling-explained/) Heating & cooling hub: HVAC costs, thermostat settings, furnace and heat-pump troubleshooting with bill math.
- [utility-bills-costs-explained](https://utilityexplained.com/utility-bills-costs-explained/) Bill basics: the four parts of any utility bill (usage, delivery, fixed charges, taxes/riders) explained.
- [lower-your-bills](https://utilityexplained.com/lower-your-bills/) Savings hub: every way to lower electric, gas, and water bills, organized by cost and effort.
- [utilities-glossary](https://utilityexplained.com/utilities-glossary/) Glossary: every utility term defined — CCF, therm, kW vs kWh, riders, franchise fees, LIHEAP and more.
- [electricity-cost](https://utilityexplained.com/calculators/electricity-cost/) Electricity cost calculator: appliance wattage × hours × your rate, with worked examples.
- [methodology](https://utilityexplained.com/methodology/) How this site sources and verifies numbers (EIA/DOE/EPA primary sources, worked math, corrections log).
- [about](https://utilityexplained.com/about/) Who publishes this site, how it is produced, and how it is funded.
- [editorial-policy](https://utilityexplained.com/editorial-policy/) Editorial standards: sourcing rules, review process, and disclosure practices.
- [corrections](https://utilityexplained.com/corrections/) Public corrections log — every material error found and fixed, with dates.

## About

Utility Explained articles are produced by an independent editorial desk and cite primary sources (government data, manufacturer specifications, and published tariffs). Data-heavy pages carry dated source links; corrections are public. See https://utilityexplained.com/about/ for editorial information.
